verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's README directly claims the ability to scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously. The webhooks docs confirm batch scrape is an async job type that reports when it starts, progresses and finishes, so you don't have to poll. Missing for 10: in-depth batch-scrape endpoint documentation (parameters, concurrency/rate limits, failure handling), independent or hands-on corroboration at the thousands-of-URLs scale.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can batch scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously

citations.quote: Get notified the moment a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, or monitor check starts, progresses, or finishes. Instead of polling for status, you provide an HTTPS endpoint
